# passage-cli v0.3.0

This release adds collections and full-text search to the Passage CLI.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owainlewis/passage-cli/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Added

- List, create, update and delete collections with `passage collection`.
- Scope a listing to one collection with `passage list --collection <slug>`, or to unfiled documents with `--collection documents`.
- Move a document with `passage move <doc> --collection <slug>`.
- Star and unstar documents with `passage star` and `passage unstar`.
- Search the full text of every document with `passage search <query>`, with optional `--collection` and `--limit`.

## Fixed

- Help flags no longer create a document.

## Notes

Written after the fact: this release shipped without a notes file.
